rangePolicy.selection: Use the supplied element values; readability and explicit user choices take priority. Record the seed and reason when choosing a combination.
rangePolicy.units: Element dimensions are preview pixels and are converted by the native draft exporter.

selection.consistency: Choose a seed for each generated text role; reuse the selected combination within a role and choose another combination only when the footage requires a distinct role.
selection.output: Save the element seed, selected element values and concrete resolved appearance values in each project text item; never emit an unsupported appearance.

font.source: The three candidates in text-elements.json have packaged font files registered in text-fonts.json; no system installation, Jianying cache or online font library is required at runtime.
font.selection: Choose an available candidate appropriate to the footage and copy; keep the primary font consistent within a role.
font.availability: Resolve each candidate through its fontId in the packaged registry. Use embedded font CSS for rendering and portable font references for native draft export; do not invent Jianying resource IDs.
font.missingCandidates: Report missing fonts; ask for a font file or an approved alternative if no candidate is available.

fill.selection: Sample a color from the element pool, inspect the footage behind the intended text placement across its visible interval, and replace the seed if the composed result is not readable.

background.selection: Do not synthesize a background; native structured text has no compatible background element.

shadow.selection: Omit shadow because no shadow element was supplied.

implementation.executor: AI agent reading this policy; no automatic pixel-analysis engine is implied.
implementation.presetResolution: Resolve every appearance through text-elements.json, sampleTextStyle and applyTextStyle; layout and timing remain separate.
implementation.unlistedPreset: Reject and report; do not synthesize a replacement style.
implementation.onUnresolvedSetting: Do not pass policy values directly as preview pixels, invent draft fields, silently omit settings or claim native support. Report the unresolved setting; if rendering is needed, disclose it and retain editable text where possible.
